global_gates: Preserve source path and sha256 for every promoted claim or candidate.
Do not use AI transcript claims as canonical truth without independent review.
Separate hypothesis/speculation/evidence for ECST/MythOS research material.
For ARDA asset/spec material, verify media-to-requirement mapping before asset-pipeline promotion.
Check Phase 2E promoted surfaces for duplicates before creating new canonical candidates.
Use reviewed-candidate status unless human/governance explicitly upgrades authority.
